cases.translation: The Philistines positioned their forces to oppose Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition навстречу (toward) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Филистимляне убили на поле сражения около четырех тысяч ___.
cases.translation: The Philistines killed about four thousand men in the field.
cases.explain: Numbers requiring a count use the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Почему Господь предал нас сегодня поражению от ___?
cases.translation: Why has the Lord defeated us today before the Philistines?
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Давайте принесем ковчег завета Господа из ___.
cases.translation: Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Shiloh.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Чтобы он был с нами и спас нас от руки ___.
cases.translation: That it may be with us and save us from the hand of our enemies.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда Ковчег Завета Господа прибыл в ___.
cases.translation: When the ark of the Lord's covenant arrived in the camp.
cases.explain: Motion into a location (в) takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.
cases.explain: Numbers use the genitive case in Russian.

cases.sentence: Двое сыновей Илия, Хофни и Пенехас, пришли вместе с ковчегом завета ___.
cases.translation: Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, came with the ark of God's covenant.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession: 'the covenant of God'.

reading.ru: И было слово Самуила ко всему Израилю.
reading.question: To whom did Samuel's word come at the beginning of this chapter?
reading.explain: The text states that Samuel's word came to all Israel.

reading.ru: Израилетяне разбили лагерь при Авенезере, а филистимляне при Афеке.
reading.question: Where did each side camp before the battle?
options: Israel at Ebenezer and Philistines at Aphek
Israel at Aphek and Philistines at Ebenezer
reading.correct: Israel at Ebenezer and Philistines at Aphek
reading.explain: The Israelites encamped by Ebenezer and the Philistines by Aphek.

reading.ru: Когда ковчег завета Господа прибыл в лагерь, все израилетяне подняли такой громкий крик, что земля откликнулась эхом.
reading.question: What happened when the ark of the covenant arrived in the camp?
options: All Israel raised a great shout so the earth resounded
reading.correct: All Israel raised a great shout so the earth resounded
reading.explain: When the ark came to the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout so the earth resounded.

reading.ru: Услышав шум восклицания, филистимляне спросили, «Что значит весь этот крик в еврейском лагере?»
reading.question: What did the Philistines ask when they heard the shout?
options: What does this great shouting in the Hebrew camp mean?
reading.correct: What does this great shouting in the Hebrew camp mean?
reading.explain: The Philistines heard the noise and asked what the great shout meant.

reading.ru: «Мы попали в беду. Ничего подобного до сих пор не случалось. Горе нам! Кто избавит нас от руки этого могучего Бога?»
reading.question: What was the Philistines' reaction when they learned God's ark was in the camp?
options: They were afraid and said nothing like this had happened before
reading.correct: They were afraid and said nothing like this had happened before
reading.explain: The Philistines said they were in trouble and had never experienced anything like this before.

reading.ru: Филистимляне сразились, и израилетяне были разбиты, потерпев большое поражение.
reading.question: What was the outcome of the battle?
options: Israel was defeated with great slaughter
No one was killed in the battle
reading.correct: Israel was defeated with great slaughter
reading.explain: The Philistines fought and Israel was defeated, suffering a great slaughter.
